title: Pass a function to map, keep and combine
objective: Give a function to map, keep or combine with using, so the list operation runs it on every item.

body.text: map, keep and combine work through a list and run a function on each item. Write using after the list, then the name of the function. map gives back a new list with each item changed. keep gives back only the items that pass the test. combine joins all the items into one value, starting from a start value.

body.title: Map with a named function
body.code:
function double
    takes number called n
    gives back n times 2

make scores equal to a list of 1, 2, 3
make doubled equal to map scores using double
say first of doubled

body.text: Inside a using line, it stands for the current item. This lets you write a short test or change without naming a function.

body.title: It stands for each item
body.code:
make scores equal to a list of 1, 2, 3
make raised equal to map scores using it plus 5
say first of raised

make numbers equal to a list of -1, 2, 3
make positive equal to keep numbers using it is greater than 0
say first of positive

body.text: The item can also be a structure. Write name of it to read one of its fields.

body.title: Read a field from each item
body.code:
structure person
    has name of type text

make people equal to a list of a person with name "Ada"
make names equal to map people using name of it
say first of names

body.text: combine takes a start value with start, and a function that receives the total so far and the next item. This adds up a list.

body.title: Add up a list
body.code:
function add
    takes number called left
    takes number called right
    gives back left plus right

make scores equal to a list of 1, 2, 3
make total equal to combine scores with start 0 using add
say total

body.prompt: Each score should go up by 1, but the program adds 5, so the first score prints 6. Make it print 2.
body.starter:
make scores equal to a list of 1, 2, 3
make raised equal to map scores using it plus 5
say first of raised
body.solution:
make scores equal to a list of 1, 2, 3
make raised equal to map scores using it plus 1
say first of raised
